summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its routine monthly notification of voting rights and capital under UK FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. As of 29 September 2026, issued share capital totaled 17,141,942,291 ordinary shares of US$0.50, with no shares held in treasury, so total voting rights equal that same figure. The notice simply supplies the denominator shareholders use for FCA and Hong Kong Part XV interest notifications. No transaction, price, stake, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed; this is an administrative disclosure, not a special situation.
